description:
Factory hardening finding from live use: running `bun run src/cli.ts loop --help` did not print help. Because the CLI only handles top-level `help`, it treated `--help` as loop args and started the default five-task loop. We had to kill the accidental Pi process and reopen the task it started.

Why this matters: a CLI used to orchestrate code-writing agents must be defensive. Help flags should never mutate Beadwork, start Pi, or touch the repo. This is especially important because users naturally try `command --help` before running a long operation.

Acceptance:
- Make `doctor --help`, `prompt --help`, `step --help`, and `loop --help` print command help without side effects.
- Ensure `loop --help` does not call `bw start`, create a run dir, or spawn Pi.
- Update README examples if needed.
- Manually verify `bun run src/cli.ts loop --help` exits zero and leaves git/Beadwork untouched.
- Keep backwards-compatible command forms for actual `step` and `loop` execution.
title: [REVIEW-S11] Make Pi factory command help side-effect free
